signals.usability_note: Clear daytime frontage of a single-story gray-sided house with an attached garage, driveway and front lawn.

renovation_activity.evidence: A patch of bare dirt or mulch at the right edge of the yard, but no equipment, materials, dumpsters or workers are visible.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is tidy and the driveway edged with stone, but nothing shows crew-level work; looks homeowner-maintained.

signals.notes: Freshly sealed asphalt driveway, red front door and a flag pole on the left suggest an owner-occupied, well-kept home; a small shed and a cart sit in the background.
